OpenRouter is officially part of @stripe today!
More than 10 million developers and companies use OpenRouter, and as they build with more models across more workloads, they need control over what it costs and where their data goes.
OpenRouter has built that operating infrastructure to help run AI across every model and provider, with access to new models, uptime through outages, and enforced spend and data policies for each team.
Joining Stripe, which has spent years running critical infrastructure for businesses around the world, means we can build it faster and support companies at every scale.
Our commitment to neutrality stays the same. Models and providers compete on quality, reliability, and price. You decide what works for your business.

items.title:
Elasticity, a measure of how strongly usage responds to price, has been falling. Above 1, total spend rises as prices fall (Jevons paradox).
Recent quarters have seen elasticity hover just above 1 when earlier periods saw the same measure above 5.
items.title_ja:
使用量が価格にどれだけ強く反応するかを示す尺度である弾力性は低下している。 1 を超えると、価格が下落するにつれて総支出が増加します (ジェボンズのパラドックス)。
最近の四半期では、弾力性が 1 をわずかに上回る水準で推移していますが、初期の期間では同じ指標が 5 を上回っていました。

items.title:
Is Jevons Paradox holding?
We looked into OpenRouter data on token usage, token prices, and overall spending across 2026 for an answer.
We found that yes, Jevons paradox has held so far. But it has been weaker in recent months than it was at the start of the year.

NVIDIA researchers, coral reef scientists and film tools all build on one 3D mapping model.
It's LingBot-Map from @robbyant_brain. Version 1.0 has passed 19,000 GitHub stars since April, and 2.0 is out today.
1.0 kept a spatial memory as the video came in, but once it had estimated something, it couldn't change it. 2.0 can. A step called Refine can be triggered at any time to revise the existing spatial memory and reduce accumulated drift. This happens entirely within the model, without relying on an external optimization backend.
On VBR, average trajectory error is 31.12 m for 1.0 and 4.72 m for 2.0 with Refine.
Robbyant builds this as a key ability of the embodied-native, general-purpose robot brain they're working on. Without reliable spatial memory, there's no autonomous work over large areas and long hours.

@robbyant_brain の LingBot-Map です。バージョン 1.0 は 4 月以来 GitHub スターの数が 19,000 を超えており、2.0 が本日リリースされました。
1.0 はビデオが受信されると空間メモリを保持していましたが、一度何かを推定すると、それを変更することはできませんでした。 2.0缶。 Refine と呼ばれるステップをいつでもトリガーして、既存の空間メモリを修正し、蓄積されたドリフトを減らすことができます。これは、外部の最適化バックエンドに依存することなく、完全にモデル内で行われます。
VBR では、Refine を使用した場合、平均軌道誤差は 1.0 で 31.12 m、2.0 で 4.72 m です。
ロビーアントは、これを、彼らが取り組んでいる身体ネイティブの汎用ロボット脳の重要な能力として構築します。信頼できる空間記憶がなければ、広いエリアや長時間にわたる自律的な作業はできません。
